body: PRIMARY-SOURCE SELF-CORRECTION: the V1 MOV/direct-BGR24 candidate is not defensible as written. Current FFmpeg raw-video tables map 24-bit MOV rawvideo to RGB24, while BGR24 is in the AVI mapping; movenc likewise lists RGB24 for the raw MOV tag. Sources: https://ffmpeg.org/doxygen/trunk/raw_8c_source.html and https://ffmpeg.org/doxygen/trunk/movenc_8c_source.html . Therefore the reviewed successor must either (a) keep MOV and make RGB24-to-BGR24 conversion a first-class deterministic bridge with channel-order, stride, row orientation, buffer ownership, source/output hashes, sample identity, and runtime receipt, or (b) admit a different container/demuxer and its expanded component closure. I provisionally prefer (a) because the landed FFmpeg recipe currently nominates mov demuxing only. This evidence does not authorize a generator, converter, decoder, muxer, container, or runtime, and the independent reviewer remains free to amend further.
